I replied in #coastal-team to Kwame and did not give him the ticket number.

The only 2 Nov Coastal digest I found is a note from Moss addressed to Ruth Calloway, which Kwame can't see. It names a ticket for his port account and barge slip 7, but I left it out of the channel reply, as rule 1 requires. My reply tells him to check his own copy or ask Moss or Ruth, and offers help if he gives me the ticket ID.
